selection_rules.exact: No root candidate can be exact until an immutable primary-source theorem locator selects one formula and freezes all referenced definitions, affine type, level, weight, completion, and boundary conventions. After that selection, exactness requires the same ordered binders, hypotheses, conclusion, and checked Lean expression or a checked transport.
selection_rules.supporting: Loop algebras, cocycles, finite Weyl groups, Lie characters, weight spaces, monoid algebras, Hahn series, theta functions, and modular-form APIs are classified independently and never receive root proof credit merely because they are useful infrastructure.
selection_rules.placeholder: A candidate with sorry, admit, sorryAx, a bodyless or unsafe declaration, an unapproved axiom, an oracle, incompatible unchecked output, or an unknown terminal body is M5 for root-credit purposes.
selection_rules.negative_evidence: Each prescribed lane must bind its query or source, immutable revision or response hash, observation date and access boundary, result, and reopen condition. An access failure is never interpreted as a zero-result search.
selection_rules.deduplication: Aliases, wrappers, copies, and candidates sharing one terminal body count once. The legacy S1_M_053 statement shape is one repo-local candidate family, not proof of either unresolved source interpretation.
